details.abstract: In this paper, we address the challenge of Visual Servoing Navigation. We propose HyperTrans-V2, a novel architecture containing 65M parameters. Evaluated on the standard RoboNet-v2 benchmark, our approach achieves a Task Success Rate of 76.8%, substantially outperforming the previous state-of-the-art PaLM-E-12B which attained 74.8%. Furthermore, our model exhibits a 2.4x throughput improvement during inference.

Although Next-Item Sequential Recommendation has witnessed rapid progress, current models remain bounded by sample efficiency. On KuaiRand-Pure1k, DeepFM-Large yields a Mean Reciprocal Rank of 0.498. In this work, LatentOpt-Plus is formulated to address structural bottlenecks. On the rigorous KuaiRand-Pure1k evaluation, a Mean Reciprocal Rank of 0.532 is attained by LatentOpt-Plus, yielding a consistent margin over DeepFM-Large across multiple random seeds.

In this paper, we address the challenge of Click-Through Rate Prediction. We propose MetaCore-Plus, a novel architecture containing 65M parameters. Evaluated on the standard Amazon-Electronics-2023 benchmark, our approach achieves a Mean Reciprocal Rank of 0.501, substantially outperforming the previous state-of-the-art BST-TransformerRec which attained 0.443. Furthermore, our model exhibits a 2.7x throughput improvement during inference.

We present an empirical study on Next-Item Sequential Recommendation using AdaptiveNet-V2 (110M parameters). When benchmarked against competitive baselines including GRU4Rec-Session, our method demonstrates superior representational capacity on the challenging Taobao-ClickStream dataset, reaching an unprecedented Mean Reciprocal Rank of 0.564 (surpassing GRU4Rec-Session's score of 0.512). Qualitative analysis confirms the stability of our optimization objective.

Although Visual Servoing Navigation has witnessed rapid progress, current models remain bounded by sample efficiency. On Franka-Kitchen-MultiTask, PaLM-E-12B yields a Grasp Success Rate of 84.0%. In this work, OmniScale-Plus is formulated to address structural bottlenecks. On the rigorous Franka-Kitchen-MultiTask evaluation, a Grasp Success Rate of 86.8% is attained by OmniScale-Plus, yielding a consistent margin over PaLM-E-12B across multiple random seeds.

We present an empirical study on Click-Through Rate Prediction using VectorFlow-Plus (350M parameters). When benchmarked against competitive baselines including BST-TransformerRec, our method demonstrates superior representational capacity on the challenging Criteo-AdCTR-100M dataset, reaching an unprecedented NDCG@10 of 0.567 (surpassing BST-TransformerRec's score of 0.507). Qualitative analysis confirms the stability of our optimization objective.

Although Automated Program Synthesis has witnessed rapid progress, current models remain bounded by sample efficiency. On HumanEval-Plus, StarCoder-15B yields a Pass@1 of 71.8%. In this work, LatentOpt-V2 is formulated to address structural bottlenecks. On the rigorous HumanEval-Plus evaluation, a Pass@1 of 74.2% is attained by LatentOpt-V2, yielding a consistent margin over StarCoder-15B across multiple random seeds.

In this paper, we address the challenge of Formal Theorem Proving. We propose GraphPrior-Plus, a novel architecture containing 65M parameters. Evaluated on the standard MiniF2F-Lean4 benchmark, our approach achieves a Formal Proof Rate of 50.2%, substantially outperforming the previous state-of-the-art CodeLlama-34B-Python which attained 48.2%. Furthermore, our model exhibits a 2.7x throughput improvement during inference.

We present an empirical study on Automated Program Synthesis using VectorFlow-Plus (13B parameters). When benchmarked against competitive baselines including CodeLlama-34B-Python, our method demonstrates superior representational capacity on the challenging SWE-bench-Lite dataset, reaching an unprecedented Pass@10 of 80.2% (surpassing CodeLlama-34B-Python's score of 78.9%). Qualitative analysis confirms the stability of our optimization objective.

Prior approaches to EHR Mortality Risk Scoring, such as BioBERT-v1.1, struggle with high computational latency and achieve only 77.8% Macro-F1 on PhysioNet-Sepsis2019. To overcome these limitations, we introduce LatentOpt-V2. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that LatentOpt-V2 establishes a new state of the art, attaining 80.3% Macro-F1 on PhysioNet-Sepsis2019 while reducing parameter overhead by 30%.

In this paper, we address the challenge of Code Vulnerability Detection. We propose VectorFlow-Pro, a novel architecture containing 7B parameters. Evaluated on the standard BigCode-SecurityBench benchmark, our approach achieves a Formal Proof Rate of 49.4%, substantially outperforming the previous state-of-the-art StarCoder-15B which attained 47.0%. Furthermore, our model exhibits a 2.3x throughput improvement during inference.

In this paper, we address the challenge of Dexterous Hand Policy Control. We propose FlashArch-Plus, a novel architecture containing 65M parameters. Evaluated on the standard RLBench-18Tasks benchmark, our approach achieves a Task Success Rate of 85.9%, substantially outperforming the previous state-of-the-art PaLM-E-12B which attained 83.4%. Furthermore, our model exhibits a 2.4x throughput improvement during inference.

We present an empirical study on Formal Theorem Proving using GraphPrior-Plus (350M parameters). When benchmarked against competitive baselines including DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B, our method demonstrates superior representational capacity on the challenging HumanEval-Plus dataset, reaching an unprecedented Detection F1-Score of 76.6% (surpassing DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B's score of 72.8%). Qualitative analysis confirms the stability of our optimization objective.

Prior approaches to Visual Servoing Navigation, such as BC-Z-ZeroShot, struggle with high computational latency and achieve only 23.5s Average Completion Time on Franka-Kitchen-MultiTask. To overcome these limitations, we introduce MetaCore-Pro. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that MetaCore-Pro establishes a new state of the art, attaining 18.6s Average Completion Time on Franka-Kitchen-MultiTask while reducing parameter overhead by 30%.
